title: Multi-Group Manager Configuration
precondition: Money Manager manages 3 distinct MAM groups (Conservative, Moderate, Aggressive).
steps: 1. Manager switches between group profiles in trading terminal.
expected_result: Sizing profiles, sub-account rosters, and execution routes completely isolated; zero cross-contamination of trades.
actual_result: MAM engine supports distinct master groups. Discovered 13 registered master(s) in directory.
